data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Provide Actionable Recommendations
features.description: Generate recommendations based on analysis to enhance pipeline efficiency.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on data-driven insights.
Suggestions include methods to reduce completion times.
Recommendations propose ways to improve success rates.
Cost-saving strategies are included in the recommendations.

features.title: Identify Areas for Optimization
features.description: Analyze data to identify areas in the pipeline that can be optimized.
acceptance_criteria: System highlights stages with the longest completion times.
Reports identify stages with the lowest success rates.

features.title: Evaluate Pipeline Execution Metrics
features.description: Develop a system to evaluate and collect metrics on pipeline execution.
acceptance_criteria: System collects data on stage completion times.
System records success rates of pipeline stages.
System logs cost breakdowns of pipeline execution.

features.title: Visualize Performance Trends
features.description: Create visualizations to display performance trends in pipeline execution.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations show trends in stage completion times.
Graphs illustrate success rates over time.
Charts display cost breakdowns for each pipeline stage.
